content.text:
The drawing shows a CHF2 carbon bonded to an oxygen. The oxygen is bonded to a CH carbon that carries a Cl and a CF3 group. This is isoflurane.

The CH carbon is a stereocentre by connectivity, but it is drawn with plain bonds, so no stereochemistry is included.

SMILES: FC(F)OC(Cl)C(F)(F)F
